met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Firozpur, Rohtak, Barabanki, Daltonganj, Contai and thence East-southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 73°E to the north of Lat. 31°N persists.
The cyclonic circulation over northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Tamil Nadu- Puducherry now lies over North Tamil Nadu & neighbourhood between 5.8 & 7.6 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood between 4.5 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Bihar & adjoining Sub-Himalayan West Bengal & Sikkim between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southeast Bay of Bengal between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Bangladesh & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over South Interior Karnataka & neighbourhoodat 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Assam & neighbourhood between 1.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
